item.title: Studio Briefing - Monday, Oct 19
item.itunes:title: Studio Briefing - Monday, Oct 19
item.description: First, the items that need your attention. Number one. The King Street Number One display on Big Bad Toy Store still shows an estimated arrival of October twenty twenty six. It's listed as a pre-order at one hundred thirty four dollars and ninety nine cents, and October has twelve days left. If the units won't reach Big Bad Toy Store this month, check with them about updating the estimate before pre-order customers start asking. Number two. There are no new fee, policy, or deadline changes from Etsy, Kickstarter, BackerKit, or Shopify. The only deadline this week is the Shopify return...
